summary_brief: 2026年4月7日，AI Agent 生态出现历史级跨平台整合里程碑：Anthropic Python/TypeScript/Go/Java 四大 SDK 首次同步支持 Bedrock Mantle 和 Mythos 预览模型，实现跨平台 Claude 部署的全面统一化——这在整个81天历史中属全新方向。评估框架质量内化达到新顶点（gptme 测试覆盖率 27%→100%，Phoenix Evals v3.0 正式弃用旧版），标志着评估工程化进入生产成熟阶段。安全修复从跨 Agent 平台协同（4月3日）→ 跨主流平台集体审计（4月6日）→ 本日 PATH 注入漏洞修复持续深入。跨仓库 Issue 层面，Bedrock 环境下 Kanban 任务崩溃（168 仓）成为历史最高频共性问题，叠加 SuperAGI CVSS 9.1 JWT 认证绕过漏洞，构成双重 P0 危机。今日信号密度（26个，高影响15个）处于中等偏高水平，但跨平台统一化这一新增突破方向使今日具有独立的历史坐标意义。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added support for Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle, set `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1`
- Changed default effort level from medium to high for API-key, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, Team, and Enterprise users (control this with `/effort`)
- Added compact `Slacked #channel` header with a clickable channel link for Slack MCP send-message tool calls
- Added `keep-coding-instructions` frontmatter field support for plugin output styles
- Added `hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle` to `UserPromptSubmit` hooks for setting the session title
- Plugin skills declared via `"skills": ["./"]` now use the skill's frontmatter `name` for the invocation name instead of the directory basename, giving a stable name across install methods
- Fixed agents appearing stuck after a 429 rate-limit response with a long Retry-After header — the error now surfaces immediately instead of silently waiting
- Fixed Console login on macOS silently failing with "Not logged in" when the login keychain is locked or its password is out of sync — the error is now surfaced and `claude doctor` diagnoses the fix
- Fixed plugin skill hooks defined in YAML frontmatter being silently ignored
- Fixed plugin hooks failing with "No such file or directory" when `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` was not set
- Fixed `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` resolving to the marketplace source directory instead of the installed cache for local-marketplace plugins on startup
- Fixed scrollback showing the same diff repeated and blank pages in long-running sessions
- Fixed multiline user prompts in the transcript indenting wrapped lines under the `❯` caret instead of under the text
- Fixed Shift+Space inserting the literal word "space" instead of a space character in search inputs
- Fixed hyperlinks opening two browser tabs when clicked inside tmux running in an xterm.js-based terminal (VS Code, Hyper, Tabby)
- Fixed an alt-screen rendering bug where content height changes mid-scroll could leave compounding ghost lines
- Fixed `FORCE_HYPERLINK` environment variable being ignored when set via `settings.json` `env`
- Fixed native terminal cursor not tracking the selected tab in dialogs, so screen readers and magnifiers can follow tab navigation
- Fixed Bedrock invocation of Sonnet 3.5 v2 by using the `us.` inference profile ID
- Fixed SDK/print mode not preserving the partial assistant response in conversation history when interrupted mid-stream
- Improved `--resume` to resume sessions from other worktrees of the same repo directly instead of printing a `cd` command
- Fixed CJK and other multibyte text being corrupted with U+FFFD in stream-json input/output when chunk boundaries split a UTF-8 sequence
- [VSCode] Reduced cold-open subprocess work on starting a session
- [VSCode] Fixed dropdown menus selecting the wrong item when the mouse was over the list while typing or using arrow keys
- [VSCode] Added a warning banner when `settings.json` files fail to parse, so users know their permission rules are not being applied

key_changes: 新增 Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) 支持，通过环境变量 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE=1` 启用
默认 effort level 从 medium 提高到 high，可通过 `/effort` 命令调整
插件技能命名规范化，通过 frontmatter `name` 字段提供稳定的调用名称
修复 429 rate-limit 响应导致代理卡住的问题，现在立即显示错误
修复 Console 登录在 macOS 上因 keychain 锁定而静默失败的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 该版本为 Claude Code v2.1.94，主要带来了 Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) 支持和默认 effort level 提升至 high 两项重要功能变更，同时修复了大量 bug，包括插件系统、UI 渲染和终端兼容性问题，提升了整体稳定性和用户体验。

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Fixed `getContextUsage()` to include agents passed via `options.agents` in the `agents` breakdown
- Fixed CJK and other multibyte text being corrupted with U+FFFD in stream-json input/output when chunk boundaries split a UTF-8 sequence
- Fixed MCP server child processes not being cleaned up when an SDK `query()` session ends
- Fixed a failed error-report write crashing the SDK process with `unhandledRejection`
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.94

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.94
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.94
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.94
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.94
```

key_changes: 修复 `getContextUsage()` 现在正确统计通过 `options.agents` 传入的 agents 使用量
修复 CJK 等多字节文本在流式输入/输出中因 UTF-8 序列被分割导致显示为 U+FFFD 的问题
修复 SDK `query()` 会话结束时 MCP 服务器子进程未正确清理导致的资源泄漏
修复错误报告写入失败时因 `unhandledRejection` 导致 SDK 进程崩溃的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要修复了 4 个 bug，包括：`getContextUsage()` 统计逻辑修复、CJK 多字节文本损坏修复、MCP 子进程清理修复以及错误处理稳定性修复。同时更新至与 Claude Code v2.1.94 保持同步。

releases.summary:
### Highlights

* **Skills:** Invoke SDK skills directly from the CLI with `/skill:name` or at startup via `--skill`. Skills are a composable extension point for domain-specific agent behaviors.
* **Themes & configuration:** New theme system with color overrides, global dotenv at `~/.deepagents/.env`, and a `DEEPAGENTS_CLI_` env var prefix for conflict-free configuration.
* **Auto-updates:** Full update lifecycle — `/update` to upgrade in-place, `/auto-update` to toggle background checks, and a refreshed install script UX.
* **Headless workflows:** Agent-friendly UX for scripted/headless invocations, AgentCore Code Interpreter sandbox provider, and improved non-interactive tracing and guidance.
* **Performance:** Sub-250ms first paint via aggressive import deferral (pydantic, adapters, heavy SDK modules), markdown stack prewarming, and reduced health-poll intervals.

### Features

* Load `~/.deepagents/.env` as global dotenv ([#1909](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/issues/1909)) ([5a21d0a](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/commit/5a21d0add1d2a885c6cd3cf36621d1da690c8db3))

无头/脚本化工作流：增强的 AgentCore Code Interpreter 沙箱、Agent 友好的无头调用支持和非交互式追踪
性能优化：亚 250ms 首次渲染，通过延迟加载 Pydantic/适配器/SDK 模块、Markdown 堆栈预热和减少健康轮询间隔
ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.0.35 版本引入了 Skills 功能，允许用户从 CLI 直接调用 SDK skills 作为可组合的领域特定代理扩展点。同时带来了全新的主题系统、全局 dotenv 配置支持和完整的自动更新生命周期。此外还增强了无头/脚本化工作流支持，并大幅优化了性能表现，首次渲染时间控制在 250ms 以内。

releases.summary:
## Mem0 OpenClaw Plugin (v1.0.4)

### Added
- **Interactive init flow**: `openclaw mem0 init` with interactive menu (email verification or direct API key). Non-interactive modes: `--api-key`, `--email`, `--email --code`
- **`memory_add` tool**: Replaces `memory_store` — name now matches `mem0` CLI and platform API
- **`memory_delete` tool**: Unified delete — single ID, search-then-delete, bulk, entity cascade. Replaces `memory_forget` and `memory_delete_all`
- **CLI subcommands**: `openclaw mem0 init`, `openclaw mem0 status` (renamed from `stats`), `openclaw mem0 config show`, `openclaw mem0 config set`
- **`import` CLI command**: Bulk-import memories from a JSON file with `--user-id` and `--agent-id` overrides
- **`event list` / `event status` CLI commands**: Monitor background processing events
- **`fs-safe.ts` module**: Isolated filesystem wrappers (sync read/write/exists/mkdir/unlink) in a separate entry point — keeps file I/O out of the main bundle
- **`backend/` module**: `PlatformBackend` with direct HTTP API access for CLI commands
- **`cli/config-file.ts`**: Persistent plugin auth storage in `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json`
- **Plugin manifest**: Added `contracts.tools`, `configSchema`, and `uiHints` to `openclaw.plugin.json`
- **Test suite**: 329 tests across 10 test files covering tools, CLI, config, dream gate, providers, and skill-loader

### Changed
- **Modular architecture**: Extracted tools into `tools/` directory (6 files) and CLI into `cli/commands.ts` — `index.ts` down from ~1700 to ~890 lines
- **Code splitting**: tsup builds with `splitting: true` and two entry points (`index.ts`, `fs-safe.ts`), separating filesystem I/O from the main bundle
- **Skills updated**: All SKILL.md files reference new tool names (`memory_add`, `memory_delete`) matching the plugin manifest
- **WRITE_TOOLS updated**: Dream gate tracks `memory_delete` and `memory_add` instead of `memory_forget` and `memory_store`
- **`mem0ai` dependency**: Updated from `2.3.0` to `2.4.5`
- **Auto-recall timeout**: Recall wrapped in 8-second `Promise.race` — if the LLM takes too long, recall is skipped instead of stalling the gateway
- **Auto-capture fire-and-forget**: `provider.add()` now runs in the background via `.then()/.catch()` — the `agent_end` hook returns immediately, zero event loop blocking
- **Auto-capture minimum content gate**: Skips extraction when total user content is <50 chars after filtering — trivial conversations ("ok", "thanks") no longer trigger LLM calls
- **CLI search**: Lowered threshold to 0.3 so explicit searches are more permissive than auto-recall
- **Init defaults**: Choice defaults to `1` (email login) on Enter, User ID defaults to OS username — no more empty values
- **Init no longer stores `baseUrl`**: Uses `https://api.mem0.ai` directly instead of persisting it to config
- **Help output reordered**: `openclaw mem0 help` now shows high-value commands first (search, add) instead of alphabetical

### Removed
- `memory_store` tool — replaced by `memory_add`
- `memory_forget` tool — replaced by `memory_delete`
- `memory_delete_all` tool — merged into `memory_delete`
- `memory_history` tool and `history` CLI command — deprecated
- **`custom_instructions` / `custom_categories` in `buildAddOptions`**: No longer injected into every auto-capture API call. Config fields (`customInstructions`, `customCategories`) remain as user-configurable options.

key_changes: 新增交互式初始化命令 `openclaw mem0 init`，支持邮箱验证或直接 API key 配置
工具重命名：memory_store → memory_add，memory_forget + memory_delete_all → memory_delete
新增多个 CLI 命令：import、event list/status、mem0 config show/set
模块化架构重构：工具提取到 tools/ 目录，CLI 提取到 cli/commands.ts，代码量精简近半
新增 fs-safe.ts 独立入口点和 PlatformBackend 模块，改进代码拆分和文件系统隔离
ai_summary.summary_cn: Mem0 OpenClaw Plugin v1.0.4 版本带来了交互式初始化流程和多个新 CLI 命令（import、event list/status、config show/set），同时对工具名称进行了规范化统一（memory_store → memory_add，memory_forget + memory_delete_all → memory_delete）。架构上进行了模块化重构，将工具和 CLI 命令分离提取，代码量从约 1700 行精简至 890 行，并新增 329 个测试用例提升代码覆盖率。需要注意的是，现有使用旧工具名的代码需要更新为新名称。

releases.author: steipete
releases.summary:
### Breaking

- Config: remove legacy public config aliases such as `talk.voiceId` / `talk.apiKey`, `agents.*.sandbox.perSession`, `browser.ssrfPolicy.allowPrivateNetwork`, `hooks.internal.handlers`, and channel/group/room `allow` toggles in favor of the canonical public paths and `enabled`, while keeping load-time compatibility and `openclaw doctor --fix` migration support for existing configs. (#60726) Thanks @vincentkoc.

### Changes

- Agents/video generation: add the built-in `video_generate` tool so agents can create videos through configured providers and return the generated media directly in the reply.
- Agents/music generation: ignore unsupported optional hints such as `durationSeconds` with a warning instead of hard-failing requests on providers like Google Lyria.
- Providers/ComfyUI: add a bundled `comfy` workflow media plugin for local ComfyUI and Comfy Cloud workflows, including shared `image_generate`, `video_generate`, and workflow-backed `music_generate` support, with prompt injection, optional reference-image upload, live tests, and output download.
- Tools/music generation: add the built-in `music_generate` tool with bundled Google (Lyria) and MiniMax providers plus workflow-backed Comfy support, including async task tracking and follow-up delivery of finished audio.
- Providers: add bundled Qwen, Fireworks AI, and StepFun providers, plus MiniMax TTS, Ollama Web Search, and MiniMax Search integrations for chat, speech, and search workflows. (#60032, #55921, #59318, #54648)
- Providers/Amazon Bedrock: add bundled Mantle support plus inference-profile discovery and automatic request-region injection so Bedrock-hosted Claude, GPT-OSS, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, and similar routes work with less manual setup. (#61296, #61299) Thanks @wirjo.
- Control UI/multilingual: add localized control UI support for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, French, Turkish, Indonesian, Polish, and Ukrainian. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins: add plugin-config TUI prompts to guided onboarding/setup flows, and add `openclaw plugins install --force` so existing plugin and hook-pack targets can be replaced without using the dangerous-code override flag. (#60590, #60544)
- Control UI/skills: add ClawHub search, detail, and install flows directly in the Skills panel. (#60134) Thanks @samzong.
- iOS/exec approvals: add generic APNs approval notifications that open an in-app exec approval modal, fetch command details only after authenticated operator reconnect, and clear stale notification state when the approval resolves. (#60239) Thanks @ngutman.
- Matrix/exec approvals: add Matrix-native exec approval prompts with account-scoped approvers, channel-or-DM delivery, and room-thread aware resolution handling. (#58635) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Channels/context visibility: add configurable `contextVisibility` per channel (`all`, `allowlist`, `allowlist_quote`) so supplemental quote, thread, and fetched history context can be filtered by sender allowlists instead of always passing through as received.
- Providers/request overrides: add shared model and media request transport overrides across OpenAI-, Anthropic-, Google-, and compatible provider paths, including headers, auth, proxy, and TLS controls. (#60200)
- Providers/OpenAI: add forward-compat `openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini`, an opt-in GPT personality, and provider-owned GPT-5 prompt contributions so Codex/GPT runs stay cache-stable and compatible with bundled catalog lag.
- Agents/Claude CLI: expose OpenClaw tools to background Claude CLI runs through a loopback MCP bridge and switch bundled runs to stdin + `stream-json` partial-message streaming so prompts stop riding argv, long replies show live progress, and final session/usage metadata still land cleanly. (#35676) Thanks @mylukin.
- ACPX/runtime: embed the ACP runtime directly in the bundled `acpx` plugin, remove the extra external ACP CLI hop, harden live ACP session binding and reuse, and add a generic `reply_dispatch` hook so bundled plugins like ACPX can own reply interception without hardcoded ACP paths in core auto-reply routing. (#61319)
- Agents/progress: add experimental structured plan updates and structured execution item events so compatible UIs can show clearer step-by-step progress during long-running runs.
- Providers/Anthropic: remove the Claude CLI backend and setup-token from new onboarding, keep existing configured legacy profiles runnable, and have `openclaw doctor` repair or remove stale `anthropic:claude-cli` state during migration.
- Tools/video generation: add bundled xAI (`grok-imagine-video`), Alibaba Model Studio Wan, and Runway video providers, plus live-test/default model wiring for all three.
- Memory/search: add Amazon Bedrock embeddings for Titan, Cohere, Nova, and TwelveLabs models, with AWS credential-chain auto-detection for `provider: "auto"` and provider-specific dimension controls. Thanks @wirjo.
- Providers/Amazon Bedrock Mantle: generate bearer tokens from the AWS credential chain so Mantle auto-discovery can use IAM auth without manually exporting `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`. Thanks @wirjo.
- Memory/dreaming (experimental): add weighted short-term recall promotion, a `/dreaming` command, Dreams UI, multilingual conceptual tagging, and doctor/status repair support, while refactoring dreaming from competing modes into three cooperative phases (light, deep, REM) with independent schedules and recovery behavior so durable memory promotion can run in the background with less manual setup. (#60569, #60697) Thanks @vignesh07.
- Memory/dreaming: add configurable aging controls (`recencyHalfLifeDays`, `maxAgeDays`) plus optional verbose logging so operators can tune recall decay and inspect promotion decisions more easily.
- Memory/dreaming: add REM preview tooling (`openclaw memory rem-harness`, `promote-explain`), surface possible lasting truths during REM staging, and make deep promotion replay-safe so reruns reconcile instead of duplicating `MEMORY.md` entries.

- Providers/Google: add model-level `cacheRetention` support for direct Gemini system prompts by creating, reusing, and refreshing `cachedContents` automatically on Google AI Studio runs. (#51372) Thanks @rafaelmariano-glitch.
- Google Gemini CLI auth: detect bundled npm installs by scanning packaged bundle files for the Gemini OAuth client config, so `npm install -g @google/gemini-cli` layouts work again. (#60486) Thanks @wzfmini01.
- Google Gemini CLI auth: detect personal OAuth mode from local Gemini settings and skip Code Assist project discovery for those logins, so personal Google accounts stop failing with `loadCodeAssist 400 Bad Request`. (#49226) Thanks @bobworrall.
- Google Gemini CLI auth: improve OAuth credential discovery across Windows nvm and Homebrew libexec installs, and align Code Assist metadata so Gemini login stops failing on packaged CLI layouts. (#40729) Thanks @hughcube.
- Google Gemini CLI models: add forward-compat support for stable `gemini-2.5-*` model ids by letting the bundled CLI provider clone them from Google templates, so `gemini-2.5-flash-lite` and related configured models stop showing up as missing. (#35274) Thanks @mySebbe.
- Google image generation: disable pinned DNS for Gemini image requests and honor explicit `pinDns` overrides in shared provider HTTP helpers so proxy-backed image generation works again. (#59873) Thanks @luoyanglang.
- Providers/Microsoft Foundry: preserve explicit image capability on normalized Foundry deployments, repair stale GPT/o-series text-only model metadata across gateway and runtime paths, and keep unknown fallback models from borrowing unrelated image support.
- Providers/Model Studio: preserve native streaming usage reporting for DashScope-compatible endpoints even when they are configured under a generic provider key, so streamed token totals stop sticking at zero. (#52395) Thanks @IVY-AI-gif.
- Providers/Z.AI: preserve explicitly registered `glm-5-*` variants like `glm-5-turbo` instead of intercepting them with the generic GLM-5 forward-compat shim. (#48185) Thanks @haoyu-haoyu.
- Amazon Bedrock/aws-sdk auth: stop injecting the fake `AWS_PROFILE` apiKey marker when no AWS auth env vars exist, so instance-role and other default-chain setups keep working without poisoning provider config. (#61194) Thanks @wirjo.
- Agents/Kimi tool-call repair: preserve tool arguments that were already present on streamed tool calls when later malformed deltas fail reevaluation, while still dropping stale repair-only state before `toolcall_end`.
- Plugins/Kimi Coding: parse tagged tool calls and keep Anthropic-native tool payloads so Kimi coding endpoints execute tools instead of echoing raw markup. (#60051, #60391) Thanks @obviyus and @Eric-Guo.
- Media understanding: auto-register image-capable config providers for vision routing, so custom GLM-style provider ids with image models stop failing with “no media-understanding provider registered”. (#51418) Thanks @xydt-610.
- Plugins/media understanding: enable bundled Groq and Deepgram providers by default so configured transcription models work without extra plugin activation config. (#59982) Thanks @yxjsxy.
- MiniMax/pricing: keep bundled MiniMax highspeed pricing distinct in provider catalogs and preserve the lower M2.5 cache-read pricing when onboarding older MiniMax models. (#54214) Thanks @octo-patch.
- MiniMax: advertise image input on bundled `MiniMax-M2.7` and `MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed` model definitions so image-capable flows can route through the M2.7 family correctly. (#54843) Thanks @MerlinMiao88888888.
- Models/MiniMax: honor `MINIMAX_API_HOST` for implicit bundled MiniMax provider catalogs so China-hosted API-key setups pick `api.minimaxi.com/anthropic` without manual provider config. (#34524) Thanks @caiqinghua.
- Usage/MiniMax: invert remaining-style `usage_percent` fields when MiniMax reports only remaining percentage data, so usage bars stop showing nearly-full remaining quota as nearly-exhausted usage. (#60254) Thanks @jwchmodx.
- Usage/MiniMax: let usage snapshots treat `minimax-portal` and MiniMax CN aliases as the same MiniMax quota surface, and prefer stored MiniMax OAuth before falling back to Coding Plan keys.
- Usage/MiniMax: prefer the chat-model `model_remains` entry and derive Coding Plan window labels from MiniMax interval timestamps so MiniMax usage snapshots stop picking zero-budget media rows and misreporting 4h windows as `5h`. (#52349) Thanks @IVY-AI-gif.
- Model picker/providers: treat bundled BytePlus and Volcengine plan aliases as their native providers during setup, and expose their bundled standard/coding catalogs before auth so setup can suggest the right models. (#58819) Thanks @Luckymingxuan.
- Tools/web_search (Kimi): when `tools.web.search.kimi.baseUrl` is unset, inherit native Moonshot chat `baseUrl` (`.ai` / `.cn`) so China console keys authenticate on the same host as chat. Fixes #44851. (#56769) Thanks @tonga54.
- Agents/Claude CLI: keep non-interactive `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` when custom `cliBackends.claude-cli.args` override defaults, including fallback resolution before the runtime plugin registry is active, so cron and heartbeat Claude CLI runs do not regress to interactive approval mode. (#61114) Thanks @cathrynlavery and @thewilloftheshadow.
- Agents/Claude CLI: persist explicit `openclaw agent --session-id` runs under a stable session key so follow-ups can reuse the stored CLI binding and resume the same underlying Claude session.
- Agents/Claude CLI: persist routed Claude session bindings, rotate them on `/new` and `/reset`, and keep live Claude CLI model switches moving across the configured Claude family so resumed sessions follow the real active thread and model. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Agents/CLI backends: invalidate stored CLI session reuse when local CLI login state or the selected auth profile credential changes, so relogin and token rotation stop resuming stale sessions.
- Agents/Claude CLI/images: reuse stable hydrated image file paths and preserve shared media extensions like HEIC when passing image refs to local CLI runs, so Claude CLI image prompts stop thrashing KV cache prefixes and oddball image formats do not fall back to `.bin`. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Agents/compaction: keep assistant tool calls and displaced tool results in the same compaction chunk so strict summarization providers stop rejecting orphaned tool pairs. (#58849) Thanks @openperf.
- Agents/failover: scope Anthropic `An unknown error occurred` failover matching by provider so generic internal unknown-error text no longer triggers retryable timeout fallback. (#59325) Thanks @aaron-he-zhu.
- Agents/subagents: honor allowlist validation, auth-profile handoff, and session override state when a subagent retries after `LiveSessionModelSwitchError`. (#58178) Thanks @openperf.
- Agents/runtime: make default subagent allowlists, inherited skills/workspaces, and duplicate session-id resolution behave more predictably, and include value-shape hints in missing-parameter tool errors. (#59944, #59992, #59858, #55317) Thanks @hclsys, @gumadeiras, @joelnishanth, and @priyansh19.
- Agents/pairing: merge completion announce delivery context with the requester session fallback so missing `to` still reaches the original channel, and include `operator.talk.secrets` in CLI default operator scopes for node-role device pairing approvals. (#56481) Thanks @maxpetrusenko.
- Agents/scheduling: steer background-now work toward automatic completion wake and treat `process` polling as on-demand inspection or intervention instead of default completion handling. (#60877) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Agents/skills: skip `.git` and `node_modules` when mirroring skills into sandbox workspaces so read-only sandboxes do not copy repo history or dependency trees. (#61090) Thanks @joelnishanth.
- ACP/agents: inherit the target agent workspace for cross-agent ACP spawns and fall back safely when the inherited workspace no longer exists. (#58438) Thanks @zssggle-rgb.
- ACPX/Windows: preserve backslashes and absolute `.exe` paths in Claude CLI parsing, and fail fast on wrapper-script targets with guidance to use `cmd.exe /c`, `powershell.exe -File`, or `node <script>`. (#60689) Thanks @steipete.
- Auth/failover: persist selected fallback overrides before retrying, shorten `auth_permanent` lockouts, and refresh websocket/shared-auth sessions only when real auth changes occur so retries and secret rotations behave predictably. (#60404, #60323, #60387) Thanks @extrasmall0 and @mappel-nv.
- Gateway/channels: pin the initial startup channel registry before later plugin-registry churn so configured channels stay visible and `channels.status` stops falling back to empty `channelOrder` / `channels` payloads after runtime plugin loads.
- Prompt caching: order stable workspace project-context files before `HEARTBEAT.md` and keep `HEARTBEAT.md` below the system-prompt cache boundary so heartbeat churn does not invalidate the stable project-context prefix. (#58979) Thanks @yozu and @vincentkoc.
- Prompt caching: route Codex Responses and Anthropic Vertex through boundary-aware cache shaping, and report the actual outbound system prompt in cache traces so cache reuse and misses line up with what providers really receive. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Agents/cache: preserve the full 3-turn prompt-cache image window across tool loops, keep colliding bundled MCP tool definitions deterministic, and reapply Anthropic Vertex cache shaping after payload hook replacements so KV/cache reuse stays stable. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Status/cache: restore `cacheRead` and `cacheWrite` in transcript fallback so `/status` keeps showing cache hit percentages when session logs are the only complete usage source. (#59247) Thanks @stuartsy.
- Status/usage: let `/status` and `session_status` fall back to transcript token totals when the session meta store stayed at zero, so LM Studio, Ollama, DashScope, and similar OpenAI-compatible providers stop showing `Context: 0/...`. (#55041) Thanks @jjjojoj.
- Mattermost/config schema: accept `groups.*.requireMention` again so existing Mattermost configs no longer fail strict validation after upgrade. (#58271) Thanks @MoerAI.
- Doctor/config: compare normalized `talk` configs by deep structural equality instead of key-order-sensitive serialization so `openclaw doctor --fix` stops repeatedly reporting/applying no-op `talk.provider/providers` normalization. (#59911) Thanks @ejames-dev.
- Anthropic CLI onboarding: rewrite migrated fallback model refs during non-interactive Claude CLI setup too, so onboarding and scripted setup no longer keep stale `anthropic/*` fallbacks after switching the primary model to `claude-cli/*`. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Models/Anthropic CLI auth: replace migrated `agents.defaults.models` allowlists when `openclaw models auth login --provider anthropic --method cli --set-default` switches to `claude-cli/*`, so stale `anthropic/*` entries do not linger beside the migrated Claude CLI defaults. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Doctor/Claude CLI: add dedicated Claude CLI health checks so `openclaw doctor` can spot missing local installs or broken auth before agent runs fail. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/auth-choice: apply provider-owned auth config patches without recursively preserving replaced default-model maps, so Anthropic Claude CLI and similar migrations can intentionally swap model allowlists during onboarding and setup instead of accumulating stale entries. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Plugins/onboarding: write dotted plugin uiHint paths like Brave `webSearch.mode` as nested plugin config so `llm-context` setup stops failing validation. (#61159) Thanks @obviyus.
- Plugins/install: preserve unsafe override flags across linked plugin and hook-pack probes so local `--link` installs honor the documented override behavior. (#60624) Thanks @JerrettDavis.
- Plugins/cache: inherit the active gateway workspace for provider, web-search, and web-fetch snapshot loads when callers omit `workspaceDir`, so compatible plugin registries and snapshot caches stop missing on gateway-owned runtime paths. (#61138) Thanks @jzakirov.
- Plugin SDK/context engines: export the missing context-engine result and subagent lifecycle types from `openclaw/plugin-sdk` so context engine plugins can type `ContextEngine` implementations without local workarounds. (#61251) Thanks @DaevMithran.
- Tasks/maintenance: reconcile stale cron and chat-backed CLI task rows against live cron-job and agent-run ownership instead of treating any persisted session key as proof that the task is still running. (#60310) Thanks @lml2468.
- Plugins: suppress trust-warning noise during non-activating snapshot and CLI metadata loads. (#61427) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Agents/video generation: accept `agents.defaults.videoGenerationModel` in strict config validation and `openclaw config set/get`, so gateways using `video_generate` no longer fail to boot after enabling a video model.
- Matrix/streaming: add a quiet preview mode for streamed Matrix replies, keep legacy `partial` preview-first behavior, and finalize quiet media captions correctly so previews stop notifying early without dropping final text semantics. (#61450) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Gateway/shutdown: bound websocket-server shutdown even when no tracked clients remain, so gateway restarts stop hanging until the watchdog kills the process. (#61565) Thanks @mbelinky.
- Control UI/multilingual: localize the remaining shared channel, instances, nodes, and gateway-confirmation strings so the dashboard stops mixing translated UI with hardcoded English labels. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Discord/media: raise the default inbound and outbound media cap to `100MB` so Discord matches Telegram more closely and larger attachments stop failing on the old low default.
- Matrix: keep direct transport requests on the pinned dispatcher by routing them through undici runtime fetch, so Matrix clients resume syncing on newer runtimes without dropping the validated address binding. (#61595) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Plugins/facades: resolve globally installed bundled-plugin runtime facades from registry roots so bundled channels like LINE still boot when the winning plugin install lives under the global extensions directory with an encoded scoped folder name. (#61297) Thanks @openperf.

releases.author: steipete
releases.summary:
## 2026.4.6

- Add workflow file support for `.lobster`, YAML, and JSON, including workflow args/env, native pipeline steps, and shell-safe `LOBSTER_ARG_*` inputs.
- Add structured input pauses with `ask`, workflow `input`, `needs_input`, and `lobster resume --response-json '{...}'` for resumable human-in-the-loop flows.
- Add richer workflow condition expressions with `!`, `==`, `!=`, `&&`, `||`, and parentheses.
- Export the embeddable runtime via `@clawdbot/lobster/core` so Lobster can run in-process inside OpenClaw and other hosts.
- Add generic `llm.invoke` adapters, `openclaw.invoke --each`, and keep `clawd.invoke` as a supported alias.
- Add compact state-backed workflow/pipeline resume tokens, safer resume validation, and hardened approval ID handling.
- Improve dry-run and shell interoperability with `exec --stdin raw|json|jsonl`, `approve --preview-from-stdin --limit N`, and better template/shell-variable preservation.
- Improve Windows CLI/build compatibility and fix quoted-argument parser edge cases.

key_changes: 工作流文件支持扩展至 .lobster、YAML 和 JSON 格式，支持工作流参数、环境变量和原生管道步骤
新增 ask/input/needs_input 等结构化输入暂停功能，支持 lobster resume --response-json 实现人机交互工作流
工作流条件表达式支持 !、==、!=、&&、|| 及括号组合，实现更丰富的条件逻辑
通过 @clawdbot/lobster/core 导出嵌入式运行时，支持在 OpenClaw 等宿主程序中内嵌运行
新增通用 llm.invoke 适配器和 openclaw.invoke --each 命令，改进 dry-run 和 exec --stdin 交互能力
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2026.4.6 版本主要增强了 Lobster 工作流的多格式支持和交互能力，新增对 .lobster、YAML、JSON 工作流文件的完整支持，并引入 ask/input 等暂停机制实现人机交互工作流。同时导出了嵌入式运行时以支持内嵌调用，并大幅改进了条件表达式、shell 互操作性和 Windows 兼容性。

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
### Bug Fixes

- Fixed **Chrome being killed after ~10s idle on Linux** caused by `PR_SET_PDEATHSIG` tracking the blocking thread that spawned Chrome rather than the daemon process. When Tokio reaped the idle thread, the kernel sent SIGKILL to Chrome even though the daemon was still alive. Orphan cleanup is handled by the existing process-group kill in `ChromeProcess::kill()` (#1157, #1173)

### Contributors

- @ctate

key_changes: 修复 Linux 上 Chrome 空闲约 10 秒后被意外终止的问题
问题根因：`PR_SET_PDEATHSIG` 跟踪了错误的线程而非守护进程
当 Tokio 回收空闲线程时，内核误将 SIGKILL 发送给 Chrome
通过现有的进程组 kill 机制处理孤立进程清理
ai_summary.summary_cn: 该版本修复了 Linux 平台上 Chrome 浏览器在空闲约 10 秒后被意外终止的严重问题。问题根源是 `PR_SET_PDEATHSIG` 信号设置追踪了生成 Chrome 的阻塞线程而非守护进程本身，导致 Tokio 回收线程时内核错误地向 Chrome 发送 SIGKILL。修复方案利用 `ChromeProcess::kill()` 中现有的进程组终止机制来正确处理孤立进程清理。

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
### New Features

- **AI chat command** - Added `chat` command for AI-powered browser automation. Supports single-shot mode (`chat "open google.com"`) and an interactive REPL. The AI agent can execute any agent-browser command via tool calls. Requires `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`. Configure the model with `--model` or `AI_GATEWAY_MODEL` (#1160, #1163)
- **Dashboard AI chat** - The observability dashboard now includes a built-in AI chat interface for conversational browser control alongside live session views (#1160, #1163)
- **`snapshot --urls`** - New `-u`/`--urls` flag to include href URLs for link elements in snapshot output, giving agents direct access to link targets without additional queries (#1160)
- **Batch argument mode** - The `batch` command now accepts commands as inline arguments in addition to reading from stdin, simplifying single-invocation multi-command workflows (#1160)

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed **`getByRole`** matching wrong elements (e.g. `<link>` stylesheet elements instead of `<a>` anchors) by rewriting the implementation to use the CDP accessibility tree with ref-based element resolution instead of CSS selectors (#1145)
- Fixed **`upload` command** not supporting accessibility tree refs (`@eN`) for file upload element selection (#1156)
- Fixed **`AGENT_BROWSER_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`** not being applied to `wait` commands. The environment variable now propagates to all wait variants (`wait`, `wait --url`, `wait --text`, `wait --load`, `wait --fn`, `wait --download`) (#1153)
- Fixed **dashboard download** error handling with improved retry logic for more reliable dashboard installation (#1154)

### Tests

- Fixed CI test failures on Windows and E2E (#1165)

### Contributors

- @ctate
- @jin-2-kakaoent
- @hyunjinee

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次扫描覆盖18个仓库，识别出5组跨仓库共性问题（P0优先级4组）和大量单仓P0/P1问题。最高频共性问题是「AWS Bedrock环境下Kanban任务崩溃」，影响168个仓库；安全类共性问题「DEV模式JWT认证绕过」涉及11个仓库；「Docker Gateway连接」和「数据库连接耗尽」各影响37和15个仓库。语义质量评分1.0，分类覆盖率100%。
global_highlights: 【P0安全】TransformerOptimus/SuperAGI等11仓存在DEV模式JWT认证绕过漏洞（CWE-287），默认配置下所有API端点完全暴露，已报告CVSS 9.1高危漏洞
【P0工作流】Bedrock连接场景下Kanban/任务执行在168个仓库中普遍崩溃，属跨仓最广泛共性问题，直接阻断核心用户工作流
【P0启动】Docker容器化部署场景下Gateway连接失败影响37仓，涉及openclaw-control-center、SuperAGI、ClawX等主流程组件
【P0质量】多个Anthropic官方SDK（Python/TS/Claude Code Action）存在缓存前缀不匹配、重试逻辑缺陷等隐性bug，持续造成用户API成本浪费和任务失败

source_issues.title: [Security] LocalCommandLineCodeExecutor executes LLM-generated code without sandboxing
source_issues.evidence: The executor writes LLM-generated code to a temp file and executes it via asyncio.create_subprocess_exec with no sandboxing. A UserWarning at construction time is the only safeguard, which is silently swallowed in most production configurations (e.g., -W ignore, logging pipelines). Attack scenario documented: indirect prompt injection tricks LLM into generating code that reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa and exfiltrates it. Impact: full system compromise, credential theft, lateral movement, data destruction.

signals.review_reason: Critical main flow blocker. Agent becomes completely unresponsive with NO visual feedback or error notification. User is left with a broken UI and no indication of what went wrong. This is a blocking failure in the primary interaction loop.

signals.review_reason: Main flow blocker — users cannot select the repository to work on. The repo picker fails even with exact name match or full URL, completely blocking the primary workflow.

source_issues.evidence: Repo picker does not show some accessible repos, even by exact name or pasted URL. User confirmed OpenHands has access to all repos. Blocks user from selecting target repository.

source_issues.evidence: User-level Skills from personal .agents repositories not loading in OpenHands Cloud. Same skill format works in repository .agents/skills/ directory. Critical feature unavailable for cloud users.

signals.topic: BlockUnknownError causes workflow blocking in multiple block types (GoogleMapsSearchBlock, AIStructuredResponseGeneratorBlock)
signals.summary: 用户在使用 GoogleMapsSearchBlock 和 AIStructuredResponseGeneratorBlock 时遭遇 BlockUnknownError，导致对应的 agent 工作流被直接阻断。其中一个 block 超时 (DEADLINE_EXCEEDED)，另一个在 AI 响应无法解析为 JSON 时崩溃，两个 block 均抛出相同的异常类型，表明这是一个跨 block 的通用异常处理缺陷。
signals.review_reason: BlockUnknownError 在至少两个不同 block 类型中复现，直接阻断 agent 执行流程。用户在使用地图搜索和结构化响应生成时均遭遇此错误，属于明确的主流程阻断。虽然 count=2 未达 P0 的 count>=3 阈值，但两个 block 的错误模式完全一致（相同异常类），且涉及真实工作流失败，因此归为 P1。

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by GoogleMapsSearchBlock with message: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED ()
source_issues.evidence: BlockUnknownError raised during Google Maps search, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED causes workflow block failure

source_issues.evidence: BlockUnknownError raised when AI response is not parseable JSON, causes block to fail and stop workflow

signals.topic: Workspace image fails to render in first assistant message with tool calls but works in subsequent messages
signals.summary: 当 copilot 通过 DALL-E + bash_exec + write_workspace_file 生成图片时，首条包含 `![alt](workspace://file-id#image/png)` 的 assistant 消息无法渲染图片。用户需重新询问才能看到图片，影响首次使用体验。经调查根因在于 `convertChatSessionMessagesToUiMessages` 合并连续 assistant 消息时的处理逻辑，以及 Streamdown 对长消息中 markdown 图片的增量渲染缺陷。
aliases: first message workspace image not rendering
markdown image rendering in merged messages
signals.review_reason: 图片生成是 copilot 的核心功能，首条消息图片不渲染是明显的 UX 缺陷，用户需要额外操作才能查看结果。Issue 提供了完整复现步骤和根因分析，明确是 message merging 导致的渲染失败，影响用户对 AI 生成内容的感知，视为体验显著下降。count=1 但影响明确，归为 P1。

source_issues.title: fix(frontend): workspace image not rendering in first assistant message with tool calls
source_issues.evidence: Image does NOT render in first assistant message when generated via DALL-E + tool calls; user must ask again to see the image; refresh page does not fix; same workspace:// URL renders fine in subsequent messages. Root cause traced to message merging logic in convertChatSessionMessagesToUiMessages and Streamdown handling of incremental rendering.

signals.topic: Backend ChatMessage ID not persisted through REST and SSE, causing frontend deduplication failures
signals.summary: Backend Prisma ChatMessage 模型有稳定的 UUID id 字段，但 Pydantic ChatMessage 模型在 `from_db()` 时剥离了该字段，导致经 REST API 获取的消息使用合成 ID (`${sessionId}-${index}`)，经 SSE 流式获取的消息使用独立的 UUID。Frontend 不得不使用 content fingerprint deduplication 函数 (`deduplicateMessages`) 来处理 ID 不一致问题，该 workaround 脆弱且增加了系统复杂度。
aliases: REST vs SSE message ID mismatch
signals.review_reason: 消息 ID 不一致导致 frontend 需要额外的 fingerprint deduplication 逻辑，增加了系统脆弱性。虽然不是直接的阻断性问题，但会影响消息展示正确性（重复或遗漏），属于非阻断性但明显的体验下降。count=1，归为 P2。

source_issues.title: Persist stable message IDs from backend through REST + SSE to frontend
source_issues.evidence: Backend Pydantic ChatMessage strips the stable UUID id field in from_db(), causing REST messages to get synthetic IDs and SSE messages to get different UUIDs. Frontend uses content fingerprint deduplication (deduplicateMessages) as a workaround. Issue documents specific files and root cause.

signals.topic: VSCode SSH remote development fails to connect when tabby server runs on localhost
signals.summary: When using VSCode with SSH remote development, the tabby VSCode extension cannot connect to a tabby server running on localhost (127.0.0.1:8080), resulting in 'Connect to Server Failed' with 'fetch failed' error. Local (non-SSH) projects work correctly. This blocks the core coding-assistance workflow for remote development users.
aliases: VSCode extension localhost connection over SSH
Remote development cannot reach localhost server
signals.review_reason: This is a real user-blocking issue: the main workflow (AI coding assistance via VSCode extension) is completely broken when using SSH remote development, because the extension cannot reach the localhost server from the remote context. The fetch failure and AggregateError are explicit evidence of connection阻断. Although count=1 prevents P0, the issue clearly meets the pain point definition (主流程失败/阻断) with reproducible steps and a clear error message.

source_issues.title: tabby vscode with SSH remote development does not connect if tabby server in localhost
source_issues.evidence: User reports that switching from local to SSH remote development causes tabby to fail with 'Connect to Server Failed' — GET http://localhost:8080/v1/health fails with 'fetch failed' and 'AggregateError'. The same setup works locally without SSH.

signals.topic: Docker 部署时无法连接 OpenClaw Gateway（主流程阻断）
signals.summary: 用户在使用 Docker 部署 openclaw-control-center 时，即使正确配置了 GATEWAY_URL，也无法连接到宿主机上的 OpenClaw Gateway，导致控制中心核心功能完全不可用。诊断页面仅显示「Gateway is not reachable」，无具体解决建议。
signals.review_reason: Docker 部署下 Gateway 无法连接是主流程阻断问题，控制中心完全无法使用。两条 issue 直接证明该问题在真实用户环境中反复出现（至少 2 个独立用户），诊断日志提供了清晰的失败证据，修复建议已在 #90 中明确。

source_issues.title: 使用 docker 的话，无法连上 gateway
source_issues.evidence: 用户配置了 GATEWAY_URL: wss://172.17.16.8:18789/ws，两个 OpenClaw 版本（2026.4.2 和 4.5）均无法连接，诊断显示 Gateway overall status: blocked，Direct probe: blocked | Unavailable | Gateway is not reachable。

source_issues.title: docs: 改进 Docker Gateway 连接配置文档和诊断提示
source_issues.evidence: Issue #86 的用户配置和诊断信息确认了 URL 格式问题（wss vs ws）、host.docker.internal 配置缺失，导致用户反复尝试不同格式均失败。诊断页面只显示「Gateway is not reachable」，不提供具体解决建议。

signals.topic: Docker 部署时群聊界面 agent 头像文件缺失导致加载失败
signals.summary: Docker 部署环境下，群聊（Hall）界面中的 agent 头像无法正确加载，显示资源加载异常。根本原因是 Dockerfile 构建时未执行头像生成脚本（npm run avatars:export），导致运行时头像文件不存在。
aliases: Hall头像文件在容器中不存在
signals.review_reason: Docker 部署时头像文件缺失是明确的 Docker 构建流程缺陷，导致群聊核心功能（头像展示）不可用。两条 issue 均来自真实部署环境，#89 提供了详细的根因代码分析，证明这是可复现的架构问题而非偶发。

source_issues.title: 群聊界面UI显示有问题【未解决】
source_issues.evidence: 用户基于 WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS Docker 部署，升级到最新版本后群聊界面 agent 头像无法正确加载，显示资源加载异常。AI 自动修复只能解决夜间模式问题，无法解决头像问题。

source_issues.title: fix: Docker 部署时 hall-avatars 头像文件缺失导致群聊界面头像加载失败
source_issues.evidence: Issue 作者通过代码分析确认根本原因：Dockerfile 只创建了空的 runtime 目录，头像生成脚本（npm run avatars:export）未在构建阶段执行，导致 staff-avatars/ 目录下的头像文件（coq.png, main.png, monkey.png 等）在容器中不存在。提供了具体的代码行引用和 Dockerfile 修复建议。

signals.topic: 群聊发送消息时报错「too many arguments for 'agent'」，功能完全不可用
signals.summary: 用户发送任何文字到群聊均报错「Runtime dispatch to architect-agent failed: error: too many arguments for 'agent'. Expected 0 arguments but got 8.」，群聊发消息功能完全不可用。
aliases: 群聊消息发送Runtime dispatch失败
signals.review_reason: 群聊发消息是核心用户流程，报错导致该功能完全不可用。虽仅单条 issue，但错误信息具体（参数传递不匹配），属于架构层面的阻断性 bug。建议升级为 P1。

source_issues.title: 群聊发送任何文字都提示错误，无法使用
source_issues.evidence: 用户实际使用群聊功能时，任何文字发送均触发 Runtime dispatch to architect-agent failed 错误，报错内容为「too many arguments for 'agent'. Expected 0 arguments but got 8.」，说明群聊发消息的核心路径存在参数传递错误。

signals.topic: AI 使用量统计中飞书/Webchat 会话被误分类为「Main/内部会话」且数据不完整
signals.summary: 控制中心「AI usage mix (all sessions)」饼图存在两个 bug：1）飞书和网页聊天会话因未被分类逻辑覆盖而被误标为「Main/内部会话」；2）累计视图使用 sessions.json 快照而非完整的 jsonl 历史事件，导致显示的使用量远低于实际。
aliases: AI usage mix饼图分类错误
累计使用量数据不准确
signals.review_reason: AI 使用量统计是用户付费计费和用量监控的核心功能，分类错误导致数据失真，用户无法准确了解各渠道的实际使用情况，属于明显的成本/数据可见性损失。虽仅单条 issue，但错误涉及两处独立代码缺陷（分类逻辑 + 数据源选择），提供了具体的函数名和根因分析。

source_issues.title: [control-center] AI usage mix: Feishu sessions misclassified + stale data in cumulative view
source_issues.evidence: 用户使用飞书和网页聊天渠道，usage-cost.ts 中的 classifySessionTypeFromSessionKey 和 classifySessionTypeLabel 函数只识别 cron/discord/telegram，Feishu 和 Webchat 穿透到默认值「Main/内部会话」。同时 buildSessionTypeBreakdownFromSessionContexts() 仅读取 sessions.json 快照而非完整 jsonl 历史，导致饼图显示的使用量远低于实际值。

signals.topic: 持续监控模式通过 CLI 轮询导致 CPU 持续满载，被动散热设备过热
signals.summary: 在 MONITOR_CONTINUOUS=true 模式下，应用通过反复 fork openclaw CLI 进程进行轮询，在空闲机器上持续占满一个 CPU 核心（100-120% CPU）。在被动散热的机器上导致持续发热，电池设备上造成严重耗电。根本原因是每次 CLI 调用约 0.5s Node 进程启动开销，2s 级别的 sessionStatus/approvals 轮询使核心始终饱和。
signals.review_reason: CPU 持续满载直接影响设备硬件健康（过热）和续航，属于可量化的用户损失。Issue 提供了精确的根因代码分析和性能数据，证明该问题在默认安装方式下影响所有 launchd 用户。虽仅单条 issue，但根因清晰、影响面广（所有默认安装用户），建议 P1。

source_issues.title: Continuous monitor mode pins CPU cores via tight-loop openclaw CLI polling
source_issues.evidence: Issue 作者提供了详细的 ps 输出，证明在 macOS Apple Silicon 机器上存在多个 openclaw 子进程同时运行（每个 100-120% CPU），新调用在旧调用结束前就已启动。根本原因代码分析精确到 src/config.ts 的 POLLING_INTERVALS_MS 配置（sessionStatus: 2000ms, approvals: 2000ms），并提供了性能测试数据（ARM64 单次冷启动 ~0.5s）。影响范围为所有使用 launchd agent 默认安装的用户，24/7 持续运行。

signals.topic: Default DEV mode bypasses all JWT authentication, exposing all API endpoints to unauthenticated access (CWE-287)
signals.summary: The check_auth() function in superagi/helper/auth.py defaults ENV to 'DEV', completely skipping JWT verification. In DEV mode, get_current_user() hardcodes admin email, granting full admin access to any unauthenticated request. All API endpoints (toolkit installation, agent creation, resource management) are unprotected by default.
signals.review_reason: CVSS 9.1 authentication bypass in default configuration. All API endpoints (toolkit installation, agent creation, resource management) are fully accessible without authentication in default deployment. Explicitly combines with RCE vector (issue #1513) for unauthenticated remote code execution. This is a primary-flow failure — the security boundary of the entire application is broken by default, affecting any user deploying SuperAGI out of the box.

source_issues.title: [SECURITY] Authentication Bypass — Default DEV Mode Skips All JWT Verification (CWE-287, CVSS 9.1)
source_issues.evidence: check_auth() defaults ENV='DEV', skipping JWT. get_current_user() hardcodes email='super6@agi.com' admin access in DEV mode. All API endpoints unprotected. Combined with RCE in issue #1513 enables unauthenticated remote code execution. CVSS 9.1.

signals.topic: Remote Code Execution via malicious toolkit installation (CWE-94)
signals.summary: Toolkit installation process allows execution of arbitrary code, enabling RCE. Combined with authentication bypass in default DEV mode, this becomes exploitable by any unauthenticated attacker.
aliases: arbitrary code execution during toolkit setup
signals.review_reason: CWE-94 Critical RCE in toolkit installation. Combined with the authentication bypass (issue #1517), any unauthenticated attacker can achieve remote code execution in default deployments. This is a complete system compromise — a primary-flow failure and the highest severity impact category.

source_issues.title: [SECURITY] Critical: Remote Code Execution via Malicious Toolkit Installation (CWE-94)
source_issues.evidence: Toolkit installation process allows execution of arbitrary code. CWE-94 severity. Title explicitly states 'Critical'. Combined with auth bypass in issue #1517 enables unauthenticated RCE.

signals.topic: SSRF in WebScraperTool — no URL validation allows internal resource access (CWE-918)
signals.summary: WebScraperTool._execute() calls requests.get(url) with no URL validation — no blocklist for internal IPs, no check for 169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata endpoint), no private IP range filtering. An LLM agent with prompt injection can be directed to scrape internal services.
aliases: unvalidated URL in web scraping tool
signals.review_reason: CVSS 7.5 SSRF with a concrete PoC showing AWS credential exfiltration via cloud metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254). Prompt injection directs the LLM agent to internal URLs — this weaponizes the agent's web scraping capability to exfiltrate cloud credentials. While preconditions exist (prompt injection), the impact (credential theft, lateral movement) is severe and well-evidenced.

source_issues.title: [SECURITY] Server-Side Request Forgery in WebScraperTool — No URL Validation (CWE-918, CVSS 7.5)
source_issues.evidence: WebScraperTool._execute() calls requests.get(url) with NO URL validation. No blocklist for internal IPs, no check for 169.254.169.254. PoC shows AWS metadata credential exfiltration via prompt injection directing agent to scrape internal URL. CVSS 7.5.

source_issues.title: [SECURITY] High: Path Traversal in Agent File Operations (CWE-22)

软件运行时自动重启网关后无响应

signals.topic: Ollama模型接口返回410错误导致无法使用
signals.summary: 用户接入Ollama本地模型服务时，ClawX返回HTTP 410 status code (no body)错误，模型调用完全失败，无法进行任何对话交互。
signals.review_reason: 单仓单条issue，但用户影响明确：Ollama本地模型是核心使用场景，返回410错误直接导致模型对话完全不可用，阻断主流程。虽count=1不足以达到P0，但鉴于主流程阻断级别给予P1。

source_issues.title: 当使用ollama模型接口服务时，提示"410 status code (no body)"错误
source_issues.evidence: 接入ollama模型时返回410状态码无响应体；Ollama服务本身正常（通过LM Studio API测试验证）；ClawX 0.3.6 on Windows11触发

signals.topic: LM Studio连接后任务卡在30%后自动取消
signals.summary: ClawX连接LM Studio本地服务器时，任务卡在约30%进度后自动取消，无法正常完成本地模型对话。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断场景：用户无法正常完成本地模型对话任务；与Ollama问题同属本地模型连接失败类问题，但根因不同（LM Studio vs Ollama），分开保留；虽count=1给予P1而非P0。

source_issues.title: ClawX hangs at ~30% when connecting to LM Studio, then cancels task
source_issues.evidence: macOS + LM Studio 0.4.9环境下，任务卡在30%后自动取消；LM Studio API测试正常（排除服务端问题）；更换baseUrl从127.0.0.1到localhost仍未解决

signals.topic: 配置多API提供商时auth-profiles未同步导致切换模型报No API key错误
signals.summary: 用户配置第2个及以上的自定义模型提供商时，auth-profiles文件未同步写入对应的key信息，导致切换模型后提示No API key found for provider错误，模型完全不可用。
aliases: auth-profiles not synced for multiple providers
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：用户配置多个API是常见使用场景；该bug导致切换模型后完全无法对话，属于配置持久化缺陷；单仓单条但影响明确，给予P1。

source_issues.title: 配置自定义模型提供商时，.openclaw\agents\main\agent文件夹下面的auth-profiles没有同步添加信息
source_issues.evidence: 配置第2个API后auth-profiles未同步写入key；重启网关后切换到第二个模型出现No API key found for provider错误；需要手动编辑auth-profiles文件才能临时解决；已有截图证据

signals.topic: /compact命令因grammy包依赖解析失败而无法执行
signals.summary: 在ClawX 0.3.6中，运行/compact命令时因命令运行时无条件引入Telegram相关模块，而grammy包未被正确提升到根路径，导致ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND错误，会话压缩功能完全不可用。
signals.review_reason: /compact是核心会话维护命令，用于压缩上下文以节省token；其失败意味着会话管理功能完全不可用，用户无法控制token消耗成本；打包回归bug影响所有非Telegram用户，给予P1。

source_issues.title: /compact fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'grammy' due to unconditional Telegram imports in command runtime
source_issues.evidence: 完整导入链追踪：/compact -> commands runtime -> sticker-cache -> import grammy -> ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND；grammy存在于dist/extensions/telegram/node_modules/但不在根路径；用户需要手动创建symlink临时绕过；该bug是打包/依赖解析回归问题

signals.topic: Agent skill 能读取 SKILL.md 但无需注册 file-reading 工具，导致行为预期不一致
signals.summary: 用户注册了 agent skill（register_agent_skill）但未注册任何文件读取工具，skill 却仍然生效并能读取文件内容。文档明确要求 skill 需要 file-reading 或 shell 工具才能访问 SKILL.md，但实际行为与文档不符，造成用户困惑。
aliases: agent reads skill without read_file tool registered
signals.review_reason: 两条 issue 均来自真实用户，指向同一根因（skill 可绕过 file-reading 工具限制读取 SKILL.md），行为与文档承诺不一致，直接影响用户对 skill 注册流程的理解和预期。count=2 达到低频阈值，P1 因其影响范围明确但非阻断性。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:Can agent skill fully take effect without explicit file-reading tool if only skill is registered?
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：注册了 skill 但未注册 file-reading 工具，skill 仍然生效。用户困惑于这是否是预期行为，与文档所述「需要 file-reading 工具才能读取 SKILL.md」相矛盾。

source_issues.title: Agent can read skills without registering any read_file tool
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告：只注册了 register_agent_skill，未注册任何文件读取工具，但 skill 仍然工作且能读取文件，且日志中无 tool usage 记录。

signals.topic: 会话重放时因进程崩溃遗留空 assistant 消息导致 API 400 错误，主流程硬阻断
signals.summary: 使用 MCP SSE 工具时，进程崩溃会导致保存空 assistant 消息到 session JSON。重新加载后，完整会话历史（含空消息）被 replay 到 LLM API，引发 400 错误（messages[N] assistant must provide content or tool_calls），之后每次调用均失败，需手动删除 session.json 才能恢复。
aliases: empty assistant message causes 400 on replay
session replay crash on MCP SSE teardown
signals.review_reason: 主流程硬阻断：崩溃后 session 损坏导致每次调用抛出 BadRequestError 400，应用完全不可用，需手动干预删除 session.json 才能恢复。有完整堆栈trace、明确环境信息和复现路径。count=1 但强用户影响证据充分，优先级 P0 不受 count 限制约束。

source_issues.title: Session replay fails with 400 when empty assistant turn saved on crash
source_issues.evidence: 完整 stack trace：AgentScope 1.0.18 + Python 3.11 + MCP SSE 场景下崩溃，session.json 保存空 assistant turn，重新加载后 API 返回 BadRequestError: messages[292] assistant must provide content or tool_calls。用户提供完整复现步骤和堆栈，确认为已知 anyio cancel scope 问题在 Python 3.10/3.11 上的触发路径。

signals.topic: SQLite and MySQL database table creation fails on retry with InvalidRequestError
signals.summary: When _create_table() encounters transient DB failures (locked database, connection timeout), the table name remains registered on shared MetaData. On retry, Table() raises 'Table X is already defined for this MetaData' — an unrecoverable error requiring process restart.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking: transient DB failures (lock, timeout) cause unrecoverable InvalidRequestError — users cannot recover without restarting the entire process. This blocks core agent session storage in production SQLite/MySQL deployments.

source_issues.title: [Bug] SQLite and MySQL _create_table raises InvalidRequestError on retry — missing extend_existing=True
source_issues.evidence: When _create_table() is called and DDL execution fails (locked database, connection timeout), the table name remains registered on shared MetaData instance. On retry, Table() raises 'Table X is already defined for this MetaData instance'. Error is unrecoverable without restarting process. Affects SQLite and MySQL deployments with transient DB issues.

signals.topic: Workflow else branch steps not executed when calling via HTTP request or agentosclient
signals.summary: When check_condition returns False via HTTP client or agentosclient, workflow outputs 'No steps executed' and silently skips else_steps. Direct run works correctly.
aliases: Workflow conditional else branch not executing
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking: workflow conditional branching silently fails via HTTP/agentosclient — else_steps never execute and users receive 'No steps executed' with no error signal. Core branching functionality is broken for remote callers.

source_issues.title: [Bug] elsesteps in workflow is not run when calling via http request or agentosclient
source_issues.evidence: When check_condition returns False via HTTP client or agentosclient, workflow outputs 'No steps executed' and skips else_steps. Direct run works correctly. The else branch is a core workflow branching mechanism that users depend on for conditional logic.

signals.topic: Agent learning mode causes infinite loop, blocking agent execution
signals.summary: When learning=True is set, the agent hangs indefinitely, making the learning feature completely unusable.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking: enabling learning=True causes the agent to hang indefinitely, wasting resources and preventing completion of agent runs. The entire learning feature is unusable.

source_issues.title: [Bug] learning is going infinite loop
source_issues.evidence: When learning=True is set, the agent takes lot of time and appears to be in infinite loop. This is a core agent capability that becomes completely unusable when enabled.

signals.topic: WebSearchTools and WikipediaTools crash agent run with unhandled network/API exceptions
signals.summary: WebSearchTools and WikipediaTools call external APIs without try/except. Network timeouts or API errors propagate as unhandled exceptions and crash the entire agent run.
aliases: Web search tool crashes on API timeout
Search tool network error crashes agent
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocking: network errors and API timeouts are common in production. When WebSearchTools or WikipediaTools encounter them, the entire agent run crashes instead of gracefully handling failure. Other tools in the same codebase already demonstrate proper error handling.

source_issues.title: [Bug] WebSearchTools and WikipediaTools crash agent on network/API errors — missing try/except
source_issues.evidence: WebSearchTools.web_search(), search_news(), and WikipediaTools.search_wikipedia() call external APIs without error handling. If DDGS API times out, network is down, or API returns error, unhandled exception propagates up and crashes entire agent run. Other tools in same codebase (PubmedTools, HackerNewsTools) already handle exceptions gracefully.

signals.topic: OpenAIEmbedder forces dimensions parameter breaking Together AI, Groq, DeepSeek, and Ollama integrations
signals.summary: OpenAIEmbedder with custom base_url injects unsupported dimensions parameter causing HTTP 400 on Together AI, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama. TogetherEmbedder also uses deprecated default model.
aliases: Embedder API compatibility with third-party providers
signals.review_reason: Significant UX degradation: users using Together AI, Groq, DeepSeek, or Ollama cannot use embedder functionality. TogetherEmbedder also fails out-of-the-box due to deprecated model. Non-blocking because core agent execution still works without embeddings.

source_issues.title: [Bug] OpenAIEmbedder forces 'dimensions' parameter with custom base_urls, breaking third-party providers
source_issues.evidence: OpenAIEmbedder with custom base_url injects dimensions parameter that Together AI, Groq, DeepSeek, and local Ollama do not support, causing HTTP 400 errors. Additionally, TogetherEmbedder default model is deprecated, causing out-of-the-box failure. Affects common third-party embedding providers.

signals.topic: MCP server tools fail to load when tool definitions include outputSchema, causing complete tool unavailability
signals.summary: opencode v1.3.17 crashes MCP server tool loading if the server's tools/list response includes outputSchema on tool definitions, immediately closing the connection and marking the server as failed. Users lose access to all MCP server tools.
aliases: MCP outputSchema causes tool loading failure
MCP server fails with outputSchema field
signals.review_reason: Key MCP server tools are completely unavailable due to a type mismatch in the fromPlugin wrapper rejecting the outputSchema field. This is a core workflow blocker: users who rely on MCP servers that include this spec-compliant field cannot use them at all. The crash is deterministic and reproducible with any affected MCP server, not theoretical.

source_issues.title: "Failed to get tools" when MCP server returns outputSchema
source_issues.evidence: opencode v1.3.17 fails to load tools from MCP servers whose tools/list response includes the outputSchema field. Connection is closed immediately after receiving the tools/list response. outputSchema is a valid optional field per MCP spec and the bundled SDK's ToolSchema. All MCP servers using this field are broken.

signals.topic: read_file tool not available for local models running on Ollama, blocking core file reading functionality
signals.summary: When using local models like gemma4:e4b via Ollama, the read_file tool is not available to the model, preventing it from reading files to perform its tasks.
aliases: read_file tool unavailable with local Ollama models
local model gemma4:e4b missing read_file tool
signals.review_reason: read_file is a foundational tool in opencode — without it, the model cannot read project files at all. When a local Ollama model is used, this tool disappears from the available set. This is a critical functional regression for local model users, blocking the primary use case. Evidence from issue #21354 confirms reproducible user impact.

source_issues.title: read_file tool call not available with local model gemma4:e4b running with Ollama
source_issues.evidence: User running opencode with local gemma4:e4b model via Ollama reports that read_file tool is not available. Without read_file, the model cannot read project files and therefore cannot assist with code tasks — this is a core feature of opencode being unavailable for local model users.

signals.topic: opencode serve hangs and stops responding to all HTTP requests including /global/health, making long-running server unusable
signals.summary: A long-running opencode serve process can enter a state where the listener remains open (epoll fd) but the polling thread stops processing requests. All HTTP endpoints hang indefinitely, requiring a hard restart.
signals.review_reason: When this bug occurs, the opencode serve instance becomes completely unresponsive with no recovery mechanism short of a hard restart. This breaks all agent integrations, external tooling, and API consumers that depend on the serve endpoint. The process appearing alive while being non-functional makes the failure particularly insidious for long-running deployments.

source_issues.title: opencode serve stops polling listener epoll fd
source_issues.evidence: The process remains alive and listening on the port, but /global/health hangs with 0 bytes received. strace shows no request/response activity on the socket. Socket state confirms the listener is registered in epoll but the polling thread has stopped. The fix requires a hard process restart.

signals.topic: Performance regression — requests taking 10+ seconds on modern hardware, affecting all workflows
signals.summary: Users report a significant performance regression where requests now take 10+ seconds even on high-spec machines (MacBook M4 Pro), likely related to heavy sandbox usage. Started approximately one week before the report.
signals.review_reason: Performance degradation from normal operation to 10+ second requests is a severe UX regression that disrupts all workflows. On a high-end MacBook M4 Pro, such delays indicate a systemic issue (potentially database or sandbox-related) rather than hardware constraints. This qualifies as a significant user impact even at count=1, given the severity and breadth of affected operations.

source_issues.title: Opencode became Insanely slow
source_issues.evidence: User on MacBook M4 Pro (high-spec hardware) reports requests taking 10+ seconds, which they describe as 'insane for what I guess is a simple db query'. Issue started ~1 week prior. User suspects correlation with heavy sandbox usage. Screenshot of the slow behavior was attached.

signals.topic: File change summary not isolated per session — changes from one session bleed into another session's summary
signals.summary: When multiple OpenCode sessions run simultaneously, the file change summary shows edits from ALL sessions to ALL sessions, instead of only showing changes made within that specific session.
aliases: file change summary shared across sessions
signals.review_reason: This is a clear data correctness bug in a user-facing UI element. When users rely on the file change summary to review what their agents have done, cross-session pollution makes it unreliable and causes active confusion. This directly degrades the user experience in multi-session workflows, a legitimate use case for power users.

source_issues.title: Session File Change Summary Not Isolated Per Session
source_issues.evidence: When Session A and Session B are active simultaneously and agents in Session B edit files, Session A's file change summary incorrectly shows those files. Users cannot trust what files were actually changed in their session, causing confusion in multi-session workflows.

signals.topic: Cache usage metadata returns null when streaming is enabled, causing token cost loss
signals.summary: When streaming mode is enabled, the API returns null values for cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens instead of actual values, meaning users pay full token prices even when cache hits should apply. Two independent reports confirm this affects the HTTP streaming path.
signals.review_reason: Two independent users confirm caching returns null in streaming mode, meaning users lose cache-hit token cost savings. This is a direct financial impact (users paying full price instead of cached price) and a main SDK feature failure. The issue is reproducible and clearly documented with screenshots and token count evidence.

source_issues.title: Caching does not work or not return cache info when streaming is enabled
source_issues.evidence: With streaming disabled, cache_read_input_tokens returns 1454. With streaming enabled, both cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens return null. Users pay full price instead of cache-hit pricing.

source_issues.title: Caching does not work or not return cache info when streaming is enabled
source_issues.evidence: HTTP mode shows correct cache info; Stream mode shows no cache info at all. Screenshots attached showing the discrepancy in response headers.

signals.topic: Paid subscription and gift plan activations fail silently, trapping users on Free plan with no support path
signals.summary: Two separate billing failures: a Max gift subscription redeemed but never applied (7+ days, no resolution), and a Claude Code agent causing ~$45 in unintended charges. Both leave users with financial loss and no working support channel.
signals.review_reason: Two distinct billing failures: one user lost 7+ days of paid Max plan access with zero resolution path (all support channels broken), another user lost ~$45 from agent errors. Both represent confirmed financial loss and service entitlement failures — critical billing issues that completely block users from accessing paid features they paid for.

source_issues.title: Gift subscription redeemed but account stuck on Free plan – no human support available
source_issues.evidence: Gift redeemed with confirmation page showing 'already redeemed' but account shows Free plan 7+ days later. Support portal shows blank page, email bot cannot escalate to human. Paid Max plan access completely lost with zero resolution path.

source_issues.title: [SUPPORT] Financial damage report - Claude Code agent errors cost ~$45 USD
source_issues.evidence: Claude Code agent (Opus 4.6) caused ~$38-45 USD in financial damage to a Max subscriber through repeated configuration errors during a Kaggle competition. Explicitly escalated to billing/support team.

signals.topic: API docs instruct to resubmit pause_turn response as-is, but API rejects it with 400 error
signals.summary: Official server tools docs tell users to pass a pause_turn response back as-is to continue, but when users do exactly that the API returns a 400 validation error. The API's own validator rejects the block that the API itself produced.
signals.review_reason: The official documentation directly contradicts the API's actual behavior — docs tell users to do X, API rejects X. This creates a trap where following the docs leads to a 400 error. Users are forced to implement a workaround that discards in-flight state, degrading the web_search pause_turn workflow significantly. While not a complete block (workaround exists), it violates the documented API contract and forces degraded behavior.

source_issues.title: pause_turn with web_search: docs say re-submit response as-is, but API returns 400 — are we missing something?
source_issues.evidence: Official docs tell users to pass paused response back as-is. API returns: 'web_search tool use was found without a corresponding web_search_tool_result block'. The API rejects the exact content it produced and instructed users to send. Workaround strips server_tool_use blocks, abandoning in-flight search state.

signals.topic: Code execution sandbox ships broken pdfplumber dependency — crashes on import due to mypyc module missing
signals.summary: pdfplumber is documented as a pre-installed package in the code execution sandbox, but it crashes immediately on import due to a missing mypyc-compiled C extension module in the sandbox image, forcing users to find workarounds like switching to pypdf.
aliases: charset_normalizer mypyc module missing in code execution
signals.review_reason: Despite being labeled as 'bug report', this is a pre-installed package that is completely broken on import. Claude Code users who rely on the documented sandbox environment for PDF processing hit a crash immediately. The sandbox image is missing a compiled C extension for charset_normalizer (dependency of pdfplumber). This blocks a documented feature of the code execution environment — users cannot use the pre-installed pdfplumber as documented.

source_issues.title: pdfplumber broken in code_execution sandbox — charset_normalizer mypyc module missing
source_issues.evidence: pdfplumber is listed as a pre-installed package but crashes immediately on import with ModuleNotFoundError for a mypyc-compiled module. Users relying on Claude to choose pdfplumber for PDF table/text extraction hit this error. Workaround requires manually switching to pypdf.

signals.topic: MCP tool image content blocks are not rendered inline in Claude.ai assistant response
signals.summary: When MCP tools return image content blocks (e.g., base64 PNG charts/diagrams), Claude can reason about them but they only appear in the collapsed tool-use accordion and never render inline in the assistant response, breaking the core value of visual MCP tools.
aliases: MCP visual tool outputs not displayed inline
image content blocks from MCP tools not visible to users
signals.review_reason: MCP visual tools returning images only render in a collapsed accordion, making them invisible to most users. This fundamentally breaks the expected UX for visual MCP tool integrations. While not a crash or financial loss, it blocks the primary use case of a first-class integration (MCP) for a significant category of tools (charts, diagrams, screenshots). However, single report and the fix likely requires changes to claude.ai frontend rather than the SDK, so P2 is appropriate.

source_issues.title: [claude.ai / MCP] Image content blocks from tool results not rendered inline in assistant response
source_issues.evidence: Claude can reason about MCP tool-returned images (visible in thinking block) but they only appear inside the collapsed 'tool use' accordion that most users never expand. Visual MCP tools (charts, diagrams, screenshots) are a major use case — if images can't surface to the user, the core value proposition of visual MCP tools is broken.

signals.topic: Streaming responses hang indefinitely when server stops sending SSE events mid-stream, with no idle timeout detection
signals.summary: When using streaming responses (messages.stream() or messages.create({ stream: true })), if the server stops sending SSE events mid-stream due to network issues or connection problems, the client waits indefinitely with 0% CPU. The existing timeout option and AbortController mechanisms cannot detect or handle stalled streams, causing complete workflow blockage with no error and no way to recover.
aliases: infinite hang on stalled SSE stream
signals.review_reason: This is a genuine user pain point: a production Claude Code CLI session completely blocked with 0% CPU and no error output, requiring manual process termination. The stream stall left the user with zero indication that anything was wrong vs 'still thinking'. Existing timeout mechanisms (overall timeout, AbortController) provably cannot detect stalled streams because the request has already started receiving data. The failure is silent, unrecoverable, causes lost work, and resource leak. Clear blocking of main workflow with documented real-world evidence.

source_issues.title: bug/proposal: infinitely hanging clients breaking bigger/complex sessions. Proposal: add Streaming Idle Timeout to Prevent Indefinite Hangs
source_issues.evidence: Real production incident documented: Claude Code CLI session (f35c7c15-802e-462b-b468-b000a96e40bb) hung at 0% CPU with no error, no output, no indication. Stream stop_reason remained null while process blocked indefinitely. User lost ~15 minutes of productivity with no recovery path except manual process kill. Related issues #842 and #844 reference similar patterns.

signals.topic: MCP tool results streamed as UserMessage cause infinite agent loops in receive_response()
signals.summary: Tool result blocks are streamed as UserMessage (indistinguishable from real user input), causing the model to interpret tool results as requiring a response and re-invoking the same tool indefinitely. This blocks the main conversation flow with no clean way to distinguish tool results from user messages without inspecting content blocks.
aliases: tool result misinterpreted as user message
signals.review_reason: This is a main-flow-blocking bug. The agent enters an infinite loop, which completely prevents the SDK from returning useful results to the user. The issue has clear reproduction steps and multiple workarounds were needed, indicating significant real-world impact.

source_issues.title: receive_response() streams tool results as UserMessage, causing agent loops
source_issues.evidence: Tool results streamed as UserMessage cause infinite loop: agent sees UserMessage (tool result) and interprets it as requiring a response, calling the tool again. Workaround requires system prompt instructions and per-turn rate limiting — defense-in-depth only.

signals.topic: setting_sources=[] silently ignored due to Python truthiness check in _build_command
signals.summary: In subprocess_cli.py, the _build_command method uses 'if self._options.setting_sources:' which treats empty list [] as falsy. This means setting_sources=[] never passes --setting-sources to the CLI subprocess — the CLI silently falls back to loading all default sources instead of loading none. This is a known-class bug (similar to allowed_tools=[] issue #634).
signals.review_reason: While only 1 issue, this is a silent failure that defeats the purpose of an explicit SDK option. The bug is well-documented with a known precedent (#634 for allowed_tools), and users must resort to undocumented workarounds to achieve the intended behavior.

source_issues.title: setting_sources=[] silently ignored due to truthiness check in _build_command
source_issues.evidence: Empty list for setting_sources is falsy, so the flag is never sent. CLI silently falls back to all default sources. User intent to disable all sources is not honored. Workaround is passing setting_sources=[''] but this is not documented.

signals.topic: Background task notification leaks into next turn's receive_response(), causing model to answer wrong questions
signals.summary: When a background task (run_in_background=true) completes between conversation turns, its TaskNotificationMessage leaks into the next receive_response() call. The model sees stale notifications and responds to the wrong query instead of the user's new message. This breaks multi-turn chat applications and causes 'answering the wrong question' behavior visible to end users.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking in multi-turn applications. The model visibly produces wrong answers (responding to stale tasks instead of the user's new message), which is directly user-visible. The issue is confirmed with a detailed reproduction script.

source_issues.title: Background task notification leaks into next turn after receive_response()
source_issues.evidence: Turn 2's receive_response() yields TaskNotificationMessage from Turn 1. Model responds with 'The background task completed successfully...' instead of answering the new query ('What is 2+2?'). Related to #558 (Second query hangs after background Task).

signals.topic: cwd ClaudeAgentOptions not honored; SDK uses random paths instead
signals.summary: The cwd option in ClaudeAgentOptions is not respected. Instead of using the specified working directory, the SDK picks random paths. This makes the SDK unreliable for any use case requiring deterministic file operations, as the agent operates on the wrong directory.
signals.review_reason: A core SDK option is not functional. This prevents users from controlling a fundamental behavior (working directory). The high comment count (10) over an extended period indicates persistent user pain. The workaround (using Opus model) is not acceptable for users who need Sonnet.

source_issues.title: `cwd` in ClaudeCodeOptions does not seem to be honored at all
source_issues.evidence: 10 comments over many months. cwd completely ignored and random paths picked even with bypassPermissions enabled. User notes it works with Opus model but not Sonnet, indicating inconsistent behavior.

signals.topic: Thinking blocks missing from agent-conversation JSONL logs in SDK v0.1.35+
signals.summary: In SDK versions 0.1.35 and later, assistant content blocks with type='thinking' are missing from agent-conversation JSONL output even when thinking is explicitly enabled. Reasoning appears in text blocks instead. This makes agent behavior hard to debug and may correlate with less consistent intermediate results.
signals.review_reason: Key debugging functionality is broken across multiple SDK versions. Agent behavior analysis is severely impaired when thinking blocks are absent from conversation logs. User reports correlation with quality degradation, suggesting this is not cosmetic.

source_issues.title: Bug: Missing `content[type="thinking"]` in Python Agent SDK agent-conversation JSONL (0.1.35+)
source_issues.evidence: Verified across multiple models (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claaude-sonnet-4-6) and SDK versions (0.1.35 through 0.1.52). User reports correlated behavior: runs without thinking blocks produce less consistent intermediate results.

signals.topic: Prompt cache prefix mismatch导致每轮消息历史重复写入缓存，用户持续承担不必要的API调用成本
signals.summary: SDK在每轮将system-reminder注入用户消息导致格式变化(Array→String)，破坏字节级前缀匹配，使整个消息历史在每轮都被标记为cache_create而非cache_read，造成约$0.08/轮的额外缓存写入开销。另一用户报告相同现象(6条评论讨论)。
signals.review_reason: 用户实际面临持续性计费损失：每轮 ~$0.08 不必要缓存写入，高频使用场景下累积成本显著。用户社区有6条评论讨论相同现象，表明这是可复现的群体性问题而非个别现象。已有关闭issue(#269)证明根因已被确认修复。

source_issues.title: Prompt cache prefix mismatch: system-reminder injection/stripping changes user message format between turns
source_issues.evidence: 每轮消息历史被标记为cache_create(~$11K tokens)而非cache_read，Opus费率下约$0.08/轮不必要开销；提供了最小化PoC和完整reproduction脚本

source_issues.title: Am I the only one struggling with invalidated caches?
